8b2(mdo sde): ston rgyas par byas nas/khye'u 'di'i ming ji skad gdags zhes ming 'dogs par byed de/khye'u 'di mig chung bas na ming mig chung zhes gdags so zhes zer ro//de nas khye'u mig chung 'o ma dang /zho dang mar dang zhun mar dang /mar gyi nying gus bskyed bsrings te mtsho'i

8b4(mdo sde): sman brtag pa dang /glang po che brtag pa dang /rta brtag pa dang /go mtshon brtag pa bslabs te/yi ge mkhas pa dang klog mkhas pa dang /mdzangs pa dang bya ba la gsal ba dang yid gzhungs pa dang brtag pa rnam pa brgyad la byang bar gyur to//de nas tshe dang ldan pa shA

8b6(mdo sde): phyin nas stan bshams pa la 'dug go//'dug nas kyang tshe dang ldan pa shA ri'i bus khyim bdag de la smras pa/khyim bdag khye'u 'di ni ma btsas pa'i snga rol nas khyod kyis bdag gi g.yog tu byin te/khong dge ba rnams ni dam bcas pa la brtan pa yin na/de kho na ltar dam
